cues.title: 先观察竖直上升
cues.caption: 先加速，再接近稳定上升。
cues.zh: 把玻璃管注满清水，放入红蜡块，用橡胶塞封好开口，再把管倒置。蜡的密度略小于水，蜡块会向上运动。刚开始它会加速，随后水的阻力增大，上升逐渐接近匀速。教材的运动合成分析从这个稳定阶段开始，不能把整个倒置和启动过程都当成匀速运动。
cues.en: Fill the tube with water, insert the red wax float, seal the opening, and invert it. Wax is slightly less dense than water, so it rises. Initially it accelerates; growing water resistance makes its rise approach a steady speed. The textbook’s composition analysis begins in that steady regime, not during the whole inversion and startup process.

cues.title: 边上升边匀速移管
cues.titleEn: Translate the tube while the wax rises
cues.caption: 两个方向，使用同一个时间。
cues.zh: 蜡块稳定上升时，把玻璃管紧贴黑板向右匀速移动。对着黑板看，蜡块既向右又向上。相同一秒内，水平和竖直方向各增加固定的位移，两者必须使用同一个时间。把每秒的位置点连接起来，会得到一条斜直线。分运动同时发生，不是先横着走，再竖着走。
cues.en: While the wax rises steadily, move the tube right at constant speed against the board. Relative to the board, the wax moves both right and up. Each second adds fixed horizontal and vertical displacements using the same elapsed time. Successive positions form a straight diagonal. Components happen simultaneously, not as a horizontal move followed by a vertical one.

cues.title: 合成位移和速度
cues.caption: 分速度比例不变，轨迹为直线。
cues.zh: 从原点到蜡块的位置，可以沿水平和竖直方向作投影。水平位移等于水平速度乘时间，竖直位移等于上升速度乘同一个时间。速度也按矢量合成，合速度大小由两个分速度的平方和开方得到。只要两个分速度都保持不变，比例就不变，所以轨迹方向保持不变，合运动也是匀速直线运动。
cues.en: Project the wax position onto the two axes. Horizontal displacement is horizontal velocity times time; vertical displacement is rise velocity times the same time. Velocities also add as vectors, with combined magnitude from the square root of the sum of their squares. Fixed components keep their ratio and direction fixed, producing uniform straight-line motion.

cues.title: 改成横向匀加速
cues.caption: 竖直等间隔，水平间隔增大。
cues.zh: 现在按教材的理想条件，保持蜡块竖直上升速度不变，让玻璃管从静止开始向右匀加速移动。每秒上升的距离相同，水平位移却依次增大。图上采用练习中的数据：每秒上升十厘米，水平每秒位移依次是四、十二、二十、二十八厘米。合运动不再沿直线，但同一时刻分运动相加的方法仍然成立。
cues.en: Under the textbook’s ideal conditions, keep vertical rise speed fixed and accelerate the tube right from rest. Each second gives the same rise but increasing horizontal travel. This example matches the exercise: ten centimetres upward each second and horizontal increments of four, twelve, twenty and twenty-eight centimetres. The combined path curves, while simultaneous component addition remains valid.

question.zh: 蜡块一边上升、一边随玻璃管横移，为什么有时走直线，有时走曲线？
question.en: A wax block rises while its tube moves sideways. Why is its path sometimes straight and sometimes curved?

lead.zh: 先等蜡块接近稳定上升，再用同一组时刻标记水平和竖直位置；比较两方向的等时间隔，而不是只看轨迹外形。
lead.en: Let the wax approach steady rise, then mark horizontal and vertical positions at the same times. Compare equal-time gaps in both directions, not just the shape of the path.

principle.zh: 两个分运动共享同一个时间。水平和竖直速度都恒定时，位移比例不变，合轨迹是直线；若水平加速而竖直保持匀速，水平间隔逐次增大，轨迹弯曲。
principle.en: Both components share one clock. Constant horizontal and vertical velocities keep the displacement ratio fixed, producing a straight path. Horizontal acceleration with steady vertical rise creates growing horizontal gaps and a curved path.

question.zh: 竖直每秒上升相同距离，水平每秒分别移动 4、12、20、28 cm，能否仍连成直线？
question.en: If equal vertical rises accompany horizontal one-second gaps of 4, 12, 20 and 28 cm, can the points still form a straight line?

explanation.zh: 不能。两方向位移比例在变化，说明速度方向也在变化。这组水平间隔每秒增加 8 cm，对应从静止开始、加速度为 0.08 m/s² 的水平匀加速运动。
explanation.en: No. The component displacement ratio changes, so the velocity direction changes. Each horizontal gap grows by 8 cm per second, matching horizontal motion from rest with constant acceleration 0.08 m/s².
